business_overview.one_sentence: 集团通过中国境内民办高校提供高等教育服务，收入主要来自预收后按服务期确认的学费和住宿费。

segments.name: Education services
segments.business_substance: Tuition fees and boarding fees from Mainland China schools
segments.source: 2023/2024 Annual Report, notes to financial statements note 5, pp.167-168

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally received in advance before each academic year and recognised over time as services are rendered.
business_notes: As at 31 August 2024, the Group's schools had approximately 139,000 students.
PRC law restricts foreign ownership in private education; the Group controls PRC operating schools and derives economic benefits through Structured Contracts rather than direct sponsor interests.
